cohort: Rat fetuses (n=75) from five pregnant dams received intra-amniotic injections of either Nirsevimab or saline.
finding: Transamniotic fetal immunotherapy (TRAFIT) with a recombinant human monoclonal antibody against RSV leads to sustained levels of the antibody in the serum and lungs of neonates at term and into the early neonatal period in a rat model.
